name: Nagami Kiyora
source:
An exquisite girl, sporting lengthy black hair and a pallid complexion, bears a striking resemblance to a doll.

Kiyora, hailing from a distinguished family of shrine maidens, wields considerable influence in the village. Her constant display of a gentle smile and her steadfast composure are noteworthy.

She is a bride candidate for the village's once-every-20-years festival.

[Translated from the [url=http://clockup.net/erewhon/character.html#char02]official website[/url]]
